title: HarfBuzz aliased gvar offsets can amplify avar2 subset resources
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not identified for this discovery)
summary: Malformed overlapping gvar offsets let many glyphs refer to one block; avar2 subsetting parsed, rewrote and retained a heap copy per glyph and retried. The maintainer reports a 251 KB input reaching 1.3 GiB and 26 seconds CPU.
ai_role: The primary maintainer commit explicitly says “Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-NJZQ4XFP.” It separately lists Claude Opus 4.8 as a commit co-author; the source does not establish that model as the discovering system or describe its investigative steps.
classification_note: The maintainer source explicitly calls this a vulnerability and describes resource exhaustion from crafted font inputs in the subset path. It does not report exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The maintainer commit documents a correction that bounds retained glyph/table work and rejects malformed input beyond the source-table budget. The commit does not establish an affected or fixed release boundary.

impacts.conditions: A crafted font with aliased gvar offsets, processed by avar2 subsetting, can amplify memory and CPU use; maintainer reports 1.3 GiB peak memory and 26 seconds for a 251 KB input.
impacts.exploitation: The cited maintainer source reports resource consumption from crafted test inputs; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
